description: This file contains pytest-based test cases for the 'index' extension of the openbb platform, specifically testing various endpoints like index constituents, historical prices, availability, search, snapshots, sp500 multiples, and sectors. It imports a custom object 'OBBject' for response validation and depends on a fixture that initializes 'obb', an object providing access to the index APIs.

methods.name: obb(pytestconfig)
methods.description: Fixture that initializes and returns the 'obb' object from the openbb module, providing access to index APIs.

methods.name: test_index_constituents(params, obb)
methods.description: Tests the 'constituents' endpoint of the index API with different parameters to verify correct response and response type.

methods.name: test_index_price_historical(params, obb)
methods.description: Tests fetching historical price data for various symbols and parameters, verifying the response and its type.

methods.name: test_index_available(params, obb)
methods.description: Tests the 'available' endpoint to ensure the list of available providers or items is correctly fetched.

methods.name: test_index_search(params, obb)
methods.description: Tests the search functionality in the index API with a query string, validating the results.

methods.name: test_index_snapshots(params, obb)
methods.description: Tests the 'snapshots' endpoint for index data snapshots based on region and provider.

methods.name: test_index_sp500_multiples(params, obb)
methods.description: Tests the endpoint fetching S&P 500 multiples series.

methods.name: test_index_sectors(params, obb)
methods.description: Tests retrieval of sector data for a given index provider.
